snippet.title: [NES 50fps] Formula 1 Sensation Lonplay
snippet.description:
F-1 Sensation (エフワン センセーション), released in Europe as Formula 1 Sensation, is a 1993 racing video game by Konami for the Family Computer, and a Formula One licensed product. It is heavily based on their 1988 MSX2+ title, F-1 Spirit 3D Special. It was Konami's final original Famicom game before re-releases.

As you can see, there's a bug in this game where, if you set the handling parameters to the worst before the race (by adjusting the tires and wings), you can easily navigate curves by turning the wheel in the opposite direction without slipping.
I've been playing this way since I was a kid, and even when I uploaded this video, I haven't seen anyone else use this technique. It might look a bit strange, but I hope you enjoy it. Thank you!

Are you interested in retrogames? Please subscribe to my channel.
https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCA2_c1M3hxWG9QIGiMxpAmg?sub_confirmation=1
